title: GenWave Persona Card
description: The <slug>.persona.json shape a GenWave station exports and imports (app repo SPEC F79.1/F79.2, format owned by GenWave-Org/genwave). additionalProperties is true throughout: readers tolerate unknown fields within the current schemaVersion major (forward-compat), so this schema only pins what the app actually reads — it never rejects a byte-valid export because of a field it doesn't yet know about.

schemaVersion.description: Card format major version. The app's current major is 1 (PersonaCard.CurrentSchemaVersion); it rejects any card whose major exceeds what it knows, but tolerates unknown fields within a known major.

tagline.description: Empty string ("") is a legal, byte-valid export — LegacyPersonaCardMapper.BuildCard hard-codes Tagline:"" for every reconciled card, so a real app export routinely carries this empty. A non-empty bar for a catalog SUBMISSION is CONTRIBUTING.md's job, not this format schema's.

soul.description: Empty string ("") is a legal, byte-valid export — LegacyPersonaCardMapper.BuildSoul returns "" when both backstory and style are empty. A non-empty bar for a catalog SUBMISSION is CONTRIBUTING.md's job, not this format schema's.

engine.description: TTS engine role, e.g. "kokoro"/"piper"; "" defers to the station's default engine.

energyDisposition.description: Station-DJ energy knob, -1..+1. The app itself does NOT bound this at construction (PersonaCard.EnergyDisposition's own remarks) — the -1..+1 range here is a deliberate catalog quality bound, not app-format law.

lore.description: Authored memory only; a station's own accrued memory is never exported.

taste.description: Authored taste rules only (source='authored'); a station's own operator/accrued rows are never exported. Omitted entirely on cards built before this field existed — never present as an explicit null.

predicate.description: AND-matched match criteria; any field left null never constrains the match.

context.description: Day-of-week/hour gate; empty daysOfWeek = every day, null hour bounds are open.

startHour.description: The app's TasteContext.StartHour is a plain nullable int with no range check — 0..23 here is a deliberate catalog quality bound, not app-format law.

endHour.description: The app's TasteContext.EndHour is a plain nullable int with no range check — 0..24 here (24 = midnight, the exclusive end of a day) is a deliberate catalog quality bound, not app-format law.

weight.description: Bias strength; negative weights are dislikes, first-class taste.

pronunciations.description: Pronunciation-guidance rules (SPEC F89.5; app-side F97.1/F97.3, PersonaCard.Pronunciations). Same forward-compat law as taste: omitted entirely on cards built before this field existed — never present as an explicit null at the card level. This schema pins types only and never rejects a byte-valid export for carrying a dead or unknown-shaped rule: the app's compile (PronunciationRuleSet.Create) provably drops a rule whose ipa contains ')', '[', or ']'; whose effective word (word if non-blank, else pattern) is not contained in pattern case-insensitively; or whose pattern, ipa, or effective word is blank — dead-rule detection is F89.7's lint, not this schema's.

word.description: The app defaults a blank word to pattern at compile; a re-serialized import that omitted word carries an explicit null (the C# record's Word has no WhenWritingNull).
